verses.text_plain: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِیمِ إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
verses.text_tajweed_html: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِیمِ إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ<tajweed class=ham_wasl> </tajweed>ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
وَقَالَ <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لۡإِ<tajweed class=ikhpiaa>نسَ</tajweed><tajweed class=madda_normal>ـ</tajweed>ٰنُ مَا لَهَا

verses.text_plain: یَوۡمَىِٕذࣲ یَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتࣰا لِّیُرَوۡا۟ أَعۡمَـٰلَهُمۡ
verses.text_tajweed_html: یَوۡمَىِٕ<tajweed class=idghaam_ghunnah>ذࣲ ی</tajweed>َصۡدُرُ<tajweed class=ham_wasl> </tajweed><tajweed class=laam_shamsiyah>ٱ</tajweed><tajweed class=ghunnah>لنّ</tajweed>َاسُ أَشۡتَا<tajweed class=idghaam_wo_ghunnah>تࣰا لّ</tajweed>ِیُرَو<tajweed class=silent>ۡا</tajweed>۟ أَعۡم<tajweed class=madda_normal>َ</tajweed>ـٰلَهُمۡ

verses.text_plain: فَمَن یَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَیۡرࣰا یَرَهُۥ
verses.text_tajweed_html: فَمَ<tajweed class=idghaam_ghunnah>ن یَ</tajweed>عۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَیۡر<tajweed class=idghaam_ghunnah>ࣰا یَ</tajweed>رَهُۥ

verses.text_plain: وَمَن یَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةࣲ شَرࣰّا یَرَهُۥ
verses.text_tajweed_html: وَمَ<tajweed class=idghaam_ghunnah>ن یَ</tajweed>عۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّة<tajweed class=ikhpiaa>ࣲ شَ</tajweed>رّ<tajweed class=idghaam_ghunnah>ࣰا یَ</tajweed>رَهُۥ
